purpose: Validation-only pilot: the v2 question set had to beat v1 on validation before any test slice was scored.
decision: not adopted: no consistent gain (v2 stack vs v1 noul: HaluEval +0.013, PHANTOM +0.004, RAGTruth -0.012); test slices not run
v1: questions v1, truncate-w16000 (validation documents fit in one window, so all v1 strategies send the same requests)
stack: logistic regression on logits, pooled validation slices weighted equally per dataset, 5-fold out-of-fold by pair_id
